Tracer Mist.name: Tracer Mist
Tracer Mist.description: The user lets a thin, harmless trace gas seep through a building, a rubble pile or a smoke-filled floor and feels it curl around everything that breathes. They learn where each person inside is, whether each is moving, still or pinned, and which gaps lead out; anyone watching closely may notice a faint haze. Strain: moderate.
